sources.title: Dunlosky, Rawson, Marsh, Nathan & Willingham (2013), Improving Students’ Learning With Effective Learning Techniques
sources.inspection_scope: Selected full-text sections: summary; practice testing implementation/overall assessment; distributed-practice discussion; interleaving cautions and concluding utility table.
sources.claim_used: Broad support for retrieval/distributed practice; applicability and limits of related techniques.
sources.limitations: University-hosted publisher PDF; selected sections only, not an independent systematic audit or assessment of all cited experiments.

sources.title: Cepeda, Pashler, Vul, Wixted & Rohrer (2006), Distributed practice in verbal recall tasks: A review and quantitative synthesis
sources.inspection_scope: Author-manuscript abstract, introduction, Method/literature-search and interval-coding sections.
sources.claim_used: Spacing and intended retention interval jointly matter; avoid universal fixed schedules.
sources.limitations: Repository author manuscript explicitly may differ from final version; verbal recall tasks, not full-day programming; not all analyses re-evaluated.

sources.title: Shute (2008), Focus on Formative Feedback
sources.inspection_scope: Author-hosted full-text abstract, introduction, Method and timing/guidelines sections.
sources.claim_used: Task-focused corrective feedback and conditional timing.
sources.limitations: Selected full-text sections; heterogeneous tasks and learners; not a universal immediate-feedback rule.

sources.title: Ericsson, Krampe & Tesch-Römer (1993), The Role of Deliberate Practice in the Acquisition of Expert Performance
sources.inspection_scope: University-hosted full-text abstract; comparison of deliberate practice with work/play; feedback/resources and music-cohort design descriptions.
sources.claim_used: Purposeful monitored subskill improvement differs from ordinary work/repetition.
sources.limitations: Original music/expertise context does not validate an hours-to-programming-mastery claim; selected sections, not all analyses.

sources.title: Sweller, van Merriënboer & Paas (2019), Cognitive Architecture and Instructional Design: 20 Years Later
sources.inspection_scope: Publisher full-text abstract; worked-example, split-attention, expertise-reversal and guidance-fading sections.
sources.claim_used: Integrate explanations and fade examples with relevant expertise.
sources.limitations: Selected sections of framework review; self-reported effort is not direct capacity measurement; not a universal schedule or practice ratio.

sources.title: Rowland (2014), The effect of testing versus restudy on retention: a meta-analytic review of the testing effect
sources.inspection_scope: PubMed abstract and bibliographic record only.
sources.claim_used: Abstract supports retrieval-versus-restudy finding and distinction of recall/recognition.
sources.limitations: Full text/methods and moderator analyses not examined; no effect-size claim.

sources.title: Brunmair & Richter (2019), Similarity matters: A meta-analysis of interleaved learning and its moderators
sources.inspection_scope: PubMed abstract and bibliographic record only.
sources.claim_used: Interleaving depends on material/similarity; not random subject rotation.
sources.limitations: Full text/methods not examined; no numerical effects reproduced. Web-reader 429/fetch failures did not reflect executor access, which succeeded.

sources.title: Macnamara, Hambrick & Oswald (2014), Deliberate practice and performance in music, games, sports, education, and professions: a meta-analysis
sources.inspection_scope: PubMed abstract, bibliographic record and linked 2018corrigendum notice.
sources.claim_used: Avoid explaining expertise by practice hours alone.
sources.limitations: Full methods and 2018 corrigendum contents not examined; withhold quantitative/domain effect claims.

sources.limitations: Primary intended scope grades 3–12, with college relevance discussed; not direct evaluation of agent tutoring or this daily schedule; selected sections.
